mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are seeing overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 44 degrees. We are expecting an overnight low of 42 degrees with some rain predicted, and the New Moon is currently in the sky.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's and Bailey's Run, or join a yoga class at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open, but please note that they are closing soon in 55 minutes, so make sure to get your order in before 10 PM.
